touchTarget.name: Minimum Touch Target
touchTarget.description: Every interactive element must have at least 44x44pt touch area

focusOrder.name: Logical Focus Order
focusOrder.description: Focus follows visual reading order: top-to-bottom, left-to-right

headingHierarchy.name: Heading Hierarchy
headingHierarchy.description: One h1 per screen, h2-h6 in logical nested order, no skip levels

contrastRatio.name: WCAG AA Contrast
contrastRatio.description: Text must meet 4.5:1 (normal) or 3:1 (large) contrast ratio

screenReaderLabels.name: Screen Reader Labels
screenReaderLabels.description: Every interactive element must have accessibilityLabel or accessibilityRole

reducedMotion.name: Reduced Motion
reducedMotion.description: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; replace animations with static transitions

dynamicType.name: Dynamic Type Scaling
dynamicType.description: Support Dynamic Type; use relative units, not fixed pixel sizes

roleMapping.name: Semantic Role Mapping
roleMapping.description: Map every component to its correct accessibilityRole
